description: Requirement and runtime configuration state different hard upload limits.

documents.text:
REQUIREMENTS
R-002: The maximum upload size is 80 MB by default.

CONFIGURATION
MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB=50
The maximum upload size is 50 MB.

description: Requirement demands expired-token rejection but implementation evidence only describes signature validation; a reasoning-capable analyzer should investigate the missing expiry check.

documents.text: R-014: The API must reject expired access tokens.
The API validates the access-token signature and issuer before accepting the request. Token expiry handling is not described in this implementation note.
